title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-aaron-li-2026-05-15
content:
Context:
- 1:1 with Aaron Li (AE) — prep for account sync on ACME Corp renewal (term ends 2026-07-10). Aaron owns renewal conversations; I'm the CSM for day-to-day health.
- Objective: align on renewal strategy, outstanding technical blockers, and who will lead the pricing conversation.
- Meeting length: 30 minutes.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick wins & health (5m) — share current usage, positive signals
2) Open technical blockers (8m) — infra/latency issues + SRE ticket status
3) Renewal posture & pricing (10m) — discount ask timing, exec intro needs
4) Action items & owners (5m)

Notes / Talking points:
- Health signals: tokens/day up 22% month-over-month; two new features in prod (semantic search + reranking) with low error rates. Customer NPS feedback: "model quality noticeable improvement" (quote from CSM survey).
- Usage pattern: bursty weekdays; average latency for 8k context runs is spiking in evenings — likely due to autoscale config. Suggest proposing small dedicated reserved window to avoid tail latency.
- Technical blocker: SRE engaged on long tail latency. Current ticket JIRA-CS-987 created 2026-05-10, assigned to infra-team, ETA for root cause analysis 2026-05-18. Need Aaron to push for priority with infra on customer-paid SLA.
- Data privacy ask: Customer requested on-prem proof-of-concept for isolated inference (private deployment). They've asked for high-level architecture and effort estimate. I drafted a one-pager (Confluence-1234). Ask Aaron if we should introduce Solutions Eng now or wait until renewal negotiation progress.

Renewal posture:
- Auto-renew window starts 2026-06-10; renewal target: full ARR renewal + 10% expansion (expected volume growth).
- Current net-retention risk: medium. Reason: pricing ask (customer will request ~20% discount) + privacy requirement (on-prem POC increases cost).
- Recommended play: push for a term commitment (12 months) with phased pricing: limited discount in exchange for commit + case study credit. If they insist on deeper discount, request exec sponsor intro to justify commercial concession.

Questions to ask Aaron:
- Have you already discussed the on-prem POC budget with the buyer? Any commercial signals?
- Any promises made during QBR that we need to honor?
- Who is our exec sponsor on the ACME side? Do you have a C-level contact we can ask for an intro?
- Can you lead the pricing ask and escalate if they push for >15% discount?

Action items (owner / due):
- Samira: finalize technical one-pager for on-prem POC and share with Aaron (due 2026-05-18).
- Aaron: confirm whether buyer has internal budget for POC and whether discount was pre-discussed (due 2026-05-17).
- Samira + Solutions Eng (TBD): scope effort estimate for 8-week POC (draft SOW) if AE confirms budget (due 2026-05-22).
- Aaron: draft renewal email to buyer proposing term + phased pricing (due 2026-05-20).
- Samira: prepare usage + performance deck for renewal call (2 slides) (due 2026-05-19).

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep ask small and measurable: request commitment to 12 months + reference case in exchange for up to 12% discount.
- If they push on on-prem now, propose a pilot that runs in our Private offering with data encryption + KMS as interim to avoid full on-prem cost.
- Bring Solutions Eng into thread only once AE confirms budget to avoid unnecessary manpower drain.

Open questions / risks to flag after meeting:
- If infra ETA slips beyond 2026-05-25, escalate to SRE lead and inform AE that this might impact renewal confidence.
- If buyer insists on >15% discount before committing to case study/reference, escalate to Sales Ops and request approval from commercial lead.

Follow-ups post 1:1 (template):
- Quick summary email to Aaron with agreed actions, owners, and due dates. Include link to Confluence one-pager and JIRA ticket.
- If AE confirms exec intro, request calendar invite and short intro blurb (who will say what).

Linked artifacts to include in follow-up:
- Confluence: acct-healthplaybook (CONFLUENCE-1234) — on-prem one-pager draft
- JIRA: JIRA-CS-987 — latency investigation ticket
- Slack: #gtm-cs thread with buyer context (share thread link)

Misc raw notes / scratch (do not send directly):
- Buyer comment (QBR): "We love the performance but concerned about data handling for sensitive docs" — use this to frame pilot as low-risk.
- Pricing negotiation tip: anchor on value (cost per successful query reduced via caching + lower ops overhead) not only token price.

Planned next check-in: 2026-05-20 (30m) — review AE outreach + SOW readiness.
summary: 1:1 prep notes + concrete action items for ACME renewal (term 2026-07-10). Focus: resolve latency blocker, scope on-prem POC, align AE on pricing/exec intro.
